endorsements.name: Ling Chuan Lee
endorsements.label: Smashing The Font Scaler Engine in Windows Kernel
endorsements.description: The Font Scaler Engine is widely used to scale the outline font definition such as TrueType/OpenType font for a glyph to a specific point size and converts the outline into a bitmap at a particular resolution. The revolution of font in computer that is mainly used for stylist purposes had make many users ignored its security issues. In fact, the Font Scaler engine could cause many security impacts especially in Windows kernel mode.
